findings.msg: The English sentence also permits the German future tense. Add correct alternatives such as «Ich werde ihn morgen sehen» and «Morgen werde ich ihn sehen».
The German future tense is also a faithful translation. Add «Ich werde es dir morgen geben» and «Morgen werde ich es dir geben».
The German future tense is also a correct translation. Add «Ich werde ihm das Buch morgen geben», «Ich werde ihm morgen das Buch geben» and «Morgen werde ich ihm das Buch geben».

The statement that the object pronoun comes right after the conjugated verb in a neutral main clause is too broad: when another element begins the sentence, a subject pronoun intervenes, as in «Morgen sehe ich ihn». Restrict the statement to clauses with the subject first.
